title: Complete negative-constraint coverage for owner session storage
requirements: Extend only DB-006 PostgreSQL tests so each accepted negative constraint has a direct synthetic assertion.
Cover an empty owner login, duplicate owner login, empty password hash and non-positive account credentials version.

With a valid persisted owner, separately cover empty token digest, empty CSRF secret, non-positive session credentials version, expiry at or before creation, last_seen before creation, revocation before creation and an unknown owner foreign key.
Preserve the existing uniquely named disposable-database setup and finally cleanup; never mutate the configured source DATABASE_URL.
Do not change migrations, application code, contracts, configuration or external integrations.
acceptance: The DB-006 tests directly prove every owner/session constraint named in its task acceptance, without relying on a different failing constraint to reject a row.
Focused PostgreSQL tests and whitespace checks pass with only test and task-spec changes.

shared_paths_approval.reason: Lead review found that DB-006 schema constraints were present but several required negative cases had no direct test; this task strengthens evidence without expanding implementation scope.
